title: Experimental approaches to data generation for REACH compliance of multi-walled carbon nanotubes: substance identification
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01017A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Marie-Léonie Bohlen, Hyun Pyo Jeon, Hana Jo, Yeojin Lee
This research evaluates standardised size, shape, and dustiness test guidelines for MWCNTs and introduces a novel, non-invasive method for characterising representative carbon nanotube length for regulatory risk assessment.
